summary: Surface live 'Available Now' badge on EV charger search results
description: Navigation search currently shows a generic availability badge pulled from a 6-hour-old POI cache. Drivers complain when they navigate to a charger that is offline or full.

summary: Connected services trial expiry notification — reduce owner confusion
description: Owners are surprised when premium features disappear because the trial-end email arrives without context. Goal: explain in the notification what the owner needs to do to maintain their tier.

summary: UNECE WP.29 cybersecurity compliance — annual attestation
description: Annual recurring task. Re-run the UNECE WP.29 / ISO 21434 evidence collection and attestation for the OTA update pipeline. Coordinate with InfoSec and external auditor.

summary: Dealer portal: SAML SSO for top-20 dealer groups
description: Strategic dealer groups want to use their own identity provider to access the dealer portal. Implement SAML 2.0 SP-initiated flow.

summary: Bulk deactivate connected services for decommissioned vehicles (no activity > 36 months)
description: Privacy program requires deactivating connected services for vehicles with no owner activity for 36 months. Need jurisdiction-specific opt-out handling and 30-day owner notice.

summary: Migrate the telematics event stream from RabbitMQ to Kafka
description: RabbitMQ doesn't scale to the volume of telemetry events now generated by the expanded vehicle fleet. Migrate the topic and consumers to Kafka.

summary: Warranty claim: push notification when parts are ordered
description: Send the owner a push notification when the service parts for their warranty claim have been ordered at the dealership. Consent required.

summary: Replace legacy VIN-scraping for inventory queries
description: Some vehicle inventory queries still scrape the legacy HOST/3270 mainframe screens. Move to the integration broker pattern per the ARB constraint.

summary: Driver app: dark mode
description: Owner requests via support are consistent. Add a dark mode option in the driver companion app for both iOS and Android.

summary: Two-factor authentication for the dealer portal
description: Compliance flagged that dealer portal users with access to owner data still log in with password only. Add TOTP-based 2FA.

summary: Audit log retention extended from 18 months to 7 years
description: Warranty and recall notification audit logs need 7-year retention to meet GDPR Article 5 and CCPA. Currently 18 months. Move older logs to cold storage after 90 days.

summary: Service history dashboard for fleet managers
description: Fleet managers ask for a daily view of service events by vehicle and reason code across their fleet. Currently they pull three different reports.

summary: Remote climate pre-conditioning ETA accuracy
description: Driver app ETA for cabin pre-conditioning is consistently 3-5 minutes optimistic in cold weather. Recalibrate using actual thermal data.

summary: Email-to-claim ingestion for roadside assistance cases
description: Owners email roadside assistance claims to assistance@apexdrive.com. These currently land in a shared inbox. Parse and create a structured ticket per claim.

summary: Navigation ranking: factor in driver charging preferences
description: Personalise navigation charging-stop suggestions based on the driver's preferred charging network and connector type. A/B test against the unpersonalised baseline.

summary: In-app payment: Apple Pay and Google Pay for connected services
description: Today connected service renewals accept credit card via web only. Add Apple Pay and Google Pay token acceptance in the driver app.

summary: OCR for handwritten service receipts
description: Some dealer service receipts are handwritten or faded. OCR them at upload so the warranty team can search by VIN and part number.

summary: Rate-limit the public vehicle status API
description: Public vehicle status endpoint is being scraped by third parties. Add per-IP and per-API-key throttling.

summary: Coverage code mapping for commercial vehicle warranty lines
description: We launched light-commercial vehicle coverage in 8 markets. Warranty coverage codes for commercial vans differ from passenger cars. Map and update RecallHub.

summary: Service advisor note templates for warranty cases
description: Senior service advisors want reusable note templates for common fault codes. Currently each advisor copies from a personal document.

summary: Migrate batch jobs from cron to Airflow
description: Nightly batch jobs (subscription tier recalc, regulator reporting) run from a single crontab with no observability. Move to Airflow with retries and SLA alerts.

summary: Post-service NPS survey after dealer visit
description: Send a 3-question NPS survey by push notification 24 hours after a confirmed dealer service visit. Opt-in only.

summary: Encrypt PII columns at rest in the owner database
description: Driver licence, date of birth, and payment instrument reference are stored in plain text in Postgres. Use column-level encryption with KMS-managed keys.

summary: Onboarding checklist automation for new service technicians
description: Manual onboarding for new dealer technicians involves 14 steps across 6 systems. Build a single workflow with status tracking.

summary: Real-time fraud scoring on connected services redemption
description: Connected service trial extensions are being abused — accounts redeemed shortly after takeover. Score every trial extension request against a fraud model.

summary: Version history for service invoices
description: When a service advisor edits a transaction record, the previous version is overwritten. Keep version history with the original on every edit.

summary: Decommission the legacy regional pricing service for connected packages
description: Read-only mirror of regional connected-services pricing still runs on the old service. Migrate the remaining consumers to the central pricing API and shut down (saves ~$9k/month).

summary: Localise the driver app to Spanish and French
description: Many of our markets have large Spanish- and French-speaking owner populations. Add es-US and fr-CA translations for the driver companion app.

summary: Peak OTA window: ephemeral CDN capacity pre-warm
description: Major software release nights cause the OTA CDN to hit throughput limits. Pre-warm edge capacity ahead of planned deployment waves and set auto-scaling policies appropriately.

summary: Replace deprecated AWS SDK v1 calls before EOL
description: AWS Java SDK v1 reaches end of life next year. Migrate the remaining ~50 call sites across telematics and OTA services to SDK v2.
